A concise web-based version of my CV is below. 

## Profile summary

Ph.D. Candidate in Computing at Queen's University and Lead Data Scientist at Venford Technologies. My work spans causal inference, Bayesian modelling, simulation, and explainable AI, with a particular focus on causal discovery, forecasting, and decision-making under changing conditions.

### Venford Technologies

**Lead Data Scientist**, 2026-Present 

- Develop modelling, simulation, and machine-learning methods for decision intelligence and digital-twin applications.
